caption: The drawing consists of a quilt-like pattern featuring a symmetrical arrangement of geometric and floral motifs in red, blue, and neutral pencil tones. At the center, there is a starburst design composed of eight radiating arms, each composed of two sections: a textured blue segment followed by a textured red segment, with a red, multi-lobed center where the arms meet. This central motif is set against a beige, cross-hatched background. Surrounding the central area is a rectangular border filled with leaf patterns sketched in pencil. Along the left and bottom edges, there is a blue vine with red, triangular flowers spaced at regular intervals. Below the central motif, a horizontal panel is divided into three squares, each containing a smaller starburst motif with alternating red and blue segments, similar to the central design, but smaller in scale and set on a beige cross-hatched background. The entire composition is framed by a pencil-drawn border with leafy details, while the red and blue elements are colored and textured, contrasting with the predominantly neutral background.
title: Pieced and Quilted Coverlet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
